prompts.ruin: Create a finished 1536x1024 TRANSPARENT architectural background asset for a 2D detailed pixel platformer, matching the subdued ornate blue-slate stone, brown timber and worn brass of reference 2. Reference1 is a coordinate-only collision guide: OMIT ALL guide lines, dots, boxes, colored fills. Reimagine this as an OPEN, ROOFLESS RUINED BELL GARDEN / sunken ancient clock courtyard. Enormous open negative sky area occupies upper central 75% of composition, actual transparency: no enclosed room, no full roof, no landscape background. Clock terrace is x704..1056 with exact floor top y528 in image. Below that terrace create a weathered stone arch foundation, two piers under its ends beginning at y552 and ending on basin floor y912, supporting terrace as one old building. Do NOT draw terrace surface itself (game has it); put architectural attachment ends flush at y552. Above its right half, behind x900,y480, a small monumental ruined brass clock shrine stands rising from y528 to y290: narrow elegant openwork bell frame, dormant weathered copper bell, an empty dark circular clock mechanism housing at y465, broken architectural crown. This must remain subdued background, leave clear quiet space in front at y500..528 for a tiny player and existing clock prop. Shrine is only x850..980 wide; the gameplay terrace is wide and OPEN, not a cramped room. At far left x192..270 and far right x1090..1152, slender ruined stone buttresses and broken trellis arches frame the courtyard, their feet at y912; tops broken around y170..260. Don't enclose upper gap: breathing room is vital. Lower basin has a quiet dark receding wall with shallow arched alcoves between y600..912, but keep left action lane x400..690,y440..900 mostly transparent/quiet. Dry dormant vines, a few bare fine branches cling to the shrine and far buttresses; NO lush living foliage yet. No grass strip along entire bottom, no landscape mountains, no clouds painted into the layer, no foreground objects, no detached props, no characters, no UI, no text. All outside architectural pixels actual alpha transparency. Crisp sophisticated low contrast native pixel detail, muted cloudy afternoon stone and dull brass, avoid high contrast edges. The result should feel like one designed grand ruined clock garden with open sky and a meaningful supported terrace, not a sprite collage.
prompts.revival: Create a perfectly registered TRANSPARENT botanical overlay for the attached ruined clock garden image, at exactly 1536x1024. KEEP the composition and plant attachment coordinates. Output ONLY newly revived leaves, flowers and very slender live vines, with everything else fully transparent. No architecture, ground, background, bell, sky, masonry or gears in output. Detailed muted green pixel art matching the image, not cartoon, no neon. Fresh fine olive and sage leaves spread over the existing dry vines: on the bell shrine at x974..1204,y294..651, especially fine branches beside its right post x1172,y420..650 and a little crown foliage near x1050,y295. Add understated pale cream and gold wildflowers and fresh small leaves along the terrace at x745..1225,y645..672, growing from its top edge, no hanging plant mats across the action space. Add delicate revived ivy on left buttress x72..242,y220..933 and right buttress x1320..1498,y220..933, rooted onto their existing stone edges; spread in several small clusters not huge opaque trees. Add low herbs and tiny cream-gold flowers along the basin plinth at y948, with living tips reaching up to y908, preserving gaps. Keep the center-left of the entire image completely empty. Brightness moderate, as though golden hour diffuse light, organic irregular arrangement. This overlay will grow outward from the central clock into the garden, so disconnected floating green specks, a solid background and independent objects are forbidden. Native pixel detail same as original. Only the sparse plant pixels, actual alpha everywhere else.
